title: § 28-507.6.2 Refusal to issue a certificate of occupancy or temporary certificate of occupancy.

blocks.html:
The department may refuse to issue a certificate of occupancy or a temporary certificate of occupancy pursuant to this section if there are outstanding violations issued by the department, penalties or open permits not signed off related for work performed under permits issued pursuant to this article until such penalties have been paid, such violations have been corrected, including filing certificates of correction, if applicable, and permits have been closed, as required by this code.
(L.L. 2024/126, 12/18/2024, eff. 6/16/2025)
